label: Fungal infection
description: Fungal infections are caused by fungi and may affect the skin or other parts of the body.

label: Allergy
description: An allergy is an immune response to a substance that is usually harmless.

label: GERD
description: Gastroesophageal reflux disease involves repeated movement of stomach contents into the esophagus.

label: Chronic cholestasis
description: Cholestasis is reduced or blocked flow of bile from the liver.

label: Drug reaction
description: Medicines can cause unwanted effects, including allergic reactions and other adverse reactions.

label: Peptic ulcer disease
description: Peptic ulcers are sores in the lining of the stomach or duodenum.

label: AIDS
description: AIDS is the most advanced stage of HIV infection. HIV testing and clinical assessment are needed to establish the diagnosis.

label: Diabetes
description: Diabetes is a condition in which blood glucose is too high.

label: Gastroenteritis
description: Gastroenteritis is inflammation of the lining of the stomach and intestines.

label: Bronchial asthma
description: Asthma is a chronic condition in which the airways become inflamed and narrow.

label: Hypertension
description: Hypertension means persistently high blood pressure and requires blood pressure measurement.

label: Migraine
description: Migraine can cause recurring headaches and other symptoms such as nausea or sensitivity to light.

label: Cervical spondylosis
description: Cervical spondylosis involves age-related changes in the joints and disks of the neck.

label: Brain hemorrhage
description: Bleeding in or around the brain is a medical emergency. Symptoms alone cannot distinguish bleeding from other types of stroke.

label: Jaundice
description: Jaundice is yellowing of the skin or eyes due to a buildup of bilirubin and can have several causes.

label: Malaria
description: Malaria is a parasitic infection usually transmitted by infected mosquitoes.

label: Chickenpox
description: Chickenpox is an infection caused by varicella-zoster virus that commonly causes an itchy rash.

label: Dengue
description: Dengue is a viral infection spread by infected mosquitoes.

label: Typhoid
description: Typhoid fever is an infection caused by Salmonella Typhi bacteria.

label: Hepatitis A
description: Hepatitis A is a liver infection caused by the hepatitis A virus.

label: Hepatitis B
description: Hepatitis B is a liver infection caused by the hepatitis B virus.

label: Hepatitis C
description: Hepatitis C is a liver infection caused by the hepatitis C virus.

label: Hepatitis D
description: Hepatitis D is a viral liver infection that occurs only in people with hepatitis B.

label: Hepatitis E
description: Hepatitis E is a liver infection caused by the hepatitis E virus.

label: Alcohol-associated hepatitis
description: Alcohol-associated hepatitis is inflammation of the liver related to alcohol use.

label: Tuberculosis
description: Tuberculosis is a bacterial infection that most commonly affects the lungs.

label: Common cold
description: The common cold is a viral infection of the upper respiratory tract.

label: Pneumonia
description: Pneumonia is an infection affecting one or both lungs.

label: Hemorrhoids
description: Hemorrhoids are swollen veins in or around the anus and lower rectum.

label: Heart attack
description: A heart attack occurs when blood flow to part of the heart is blocked. It requires emergency care.

label: Varicose veins
description: Varicose veins are enlarged, twisted veins, often in the legs.

label: Hypothyroidism
description: Hypothyroidism means the thyroid gland does not make enough thyroid hormone.

label: Hyperthyroidism
description: Hyperthyroidism means the thyroid gland makes too much thyroid hormone.

label: Hypoglycemia
description: Hypoglycemia means blood glucose is lower than normal.

label: Osteoarthritis
description: Osteoarthritis is a joint disease involving breakdown of cartilage and changes in other joint tissues.

label: Arthritis
description: Arthritis refers to a group of conditions that affect the joints.

label: Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo
description: Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo causes brief episodes of dizziness with certain head movements.

label: Acne
description: Acne develops when hair follicles become clogged with oil and dead skin cells.

label: Urinary tract infection
description: A urinary tract infection can affect the bladder, kidneys, or other parts of the urinary tract.

label: Psoriasis
description: Psoriasis is a chronic disease that can cause patches of thick, scaly skin.

label: Impetigo
description: Impetigo is a contagious bacterial skin infection.
